name: ui-select-tick
prompt: A single short dry plastic button click, crisp and quiet, no reverb.

name: ui-select-card
prompt: A fingernail lightly tapping the edge of a playing card once, thin paper tick.

name: ui-confirm
prompt: A small wooden toggle switch flipped firmly to the on position, positive muted click.

name: ui-confirm-chip
prompt: A single poker chip set down on a polished wooden card table, clean plastic clack.

name: card-play
prompt: A playing card slapped face-up onto a wooden table, sharp paper snap with a soft knock.

name: card-play-felt
prompt: A playing card placed gently onto green felt, soft muffled paper tap.

name: card-draw
prompt: A single playing card dealt quickly off the top of a deck, short paper swish.

name: wild-eight-chime
prompt: Three bright ascending brass chimes struck in sequence with a light magical shimmer tail.

name: ui-error-buzz
prompt: A single low dull knock on hollow wood, short negative thud, no ringing.

name: victory-fanfare
prompt: A short triumphant brass fanfare, four rising trumpet notes ending on a bright held chord.

name: defeat-descend
prompt: Three slow descending muted trombone notes, gentle and sad, fading softly.

name: turn-notify
prompt: A small brass desk bell tapped once with a metal striker, soft clear ding.

name: turn-tap
prompt: Two knuckles knocking lightly twice on a wooden railway compartment table.
